executionHistory.summary: SCOPE-01 durable synthesis persistence. Migration 064 adds synthesis_runs, synthesis_run_attempts, synthesis_outputs, synthesis_output_insights and synthesis_citations. New tables rather than reusing synthesis_insights because that row has no run identity, window or policy version, and a UNIQUE constraint needs something to be unique ON. Idempotence is a UNIQUE index on logical_key, not a read-then-write guard that would race. Attempts are written OUTSIDE the content transaction so a failure survives its rollback, and carry no candidate text or source ids. Post-commit read-back is a mandatory gate calling the same production reader, because the defect being repaired is a producer that reported success having written nothing.

Source-set fingerprints now identify idempotent input while an actor/cadence/window advisory transaction lock serializes same-window work; same-source replay appends an idempotent attempt, changed-source reruns append a new run/output and supersede-before-insert under the unique-current invariant, crash rollback preserves the prior current aggregate, schema/citations/source authorization validate before commit, and immutable run events preserve history.
